name: prose-tell-scan
description: Deterministic prose measurement: catalogued AI writing tells and cadence metrics, calibrated against your own corpus.

interface.shortDescription: Counts the AI writing tells a regex can catch, against your own calibrated corpus.
interface.longDescription: Deterministic prose measurement: a catalogued scan for AI writing tells plus the cadence metrics a model cannot estimate about its own output. Register-aware, calibrated against your own corpus, and report-only — signals for an author about their own draft, never a verdict about who wrote something. Ships no rewriter, by design. It reports signals for the author to weigh and never states or implies who wrote a document. The judgement half of this bundle — a critic for the patterns a regex cannot decide — is authored but deliberately not shipped; see primitives/agents/prose-pattern-critic/meta.yaml for why.
defaultPrompt: Scan this draft for AI writing tells
Check whether my revision actually removed the tells
Calibrate a writing profile against my own corpus
Which sentences here could not be wrong?
